prompt: Create a cinematic fantasy realism scene in a sun-dappled ancient forest: a close-up three-quarter profile of a young human adventurer, a wide-eyed young boy, crouching or kneeling at the left foreground, gazing upward in astonishment with parted lips as if asking, “Are you talking to me?” He has tousled dark brown hair, warm skin with tiny flecks of forest dust, expressive brown eyes, and wears weathered dark leather adventurer armor with layered shoulder pieces, straps, buckles, metal clasps, and the suggestion of a sword hilt behind him. Floating at eye level on the right is exactly one tiny fairy, a delicate blonde female fairy with pointed ears, a messy bun, small white flowers in her hair, and a leafy cream-and-pale-green petal dress, leaning forward and reaching out one hand toward him. The fairy has exactly two large translucent insect-like wings with fine golden veins, bare feet, vine anklets, and trailing glowing filaments ending in droplets of light. Surround both characters with dozens of warm golden firefly-like sparkles and magical dust motes, strongest around the fairy. Use a shallow depth of field with a softly blurred green forest background, tall tree trunks, moss, leaves, and bokeh sunlight filtering through the canopy. Lighting should be golden backlight and rim light, creating luminous wing edges, realistic skin highlights, and a dreamy magical atmosphere. Composition: square image, boy’s face large on the left occupying about half the frame, fairy hovering on the upper right facing him, their eye contact as the emotional focus. Style: ultra-detailed photorealistic fantasy film still, high dynamic range, natural textures, soft cinematic color grading, no text, no watermark, no extra fairies or characters.

promptZh: 创作一个阳光斑驳的古老森林中的电影感奇幻写实场景：画面左前方是一个年轻人类冒险者的四分之三侧面特写，一个瞪大眼睛的小男孩，他蹲着或跪着，惊讶地抬头凝视，嘴唇微张，仿佛在问：“你在跟我说话吗？”他有着凌乱的 深棕色 头发，温暖的皮肤上沾着细小的森林尘埃，眼神深邃，身穿磨损的深色皮革冒险者盔甲，配有分层肩甲、绑带、搭扣、金属扣环，身后隐约可见剑柄。右侧视线平齐处悬浮着一只微小的仙子，一位精致的金发女性仙子，有着尖耳朵、凌乱的发髻，发间点缀着小白花，身穿叶片状的奶油色和淡绿色花瓣裙，正向前倾身并向他伸出一只手。仙子拥有一对巨大的半透明昆虫翅膀，翅脉清晰，赤着双脚，戴着藤蔓脚链，身后拖曳着发光的丝状物，末端闪烁着点点光芒。在两人周围环绕着数十个温暖的金色萤火虫般的火花和魔法尘埃，仙子周围最为密集。使用浅景深效果，背景是柔焦的绿色森林、高大的树干、苔藓、树叶以及透过树冠的散景阳光。光影采用金色的背光和轮廓光，勾勒出明亮的翅膀边缘，呈现真实的皮肤高光，营造出梦幻般的魔法氛围。构图：正方形图像，男孩的脸占据左侧约一半的画面，仙子悬浮在右上角面向他，两人的目光接触是情感焦点。风格：超细节的写实奇幻电影剧照，高动态范围，自然纹理，柔和的电影级调色，无文字，无水印，无多余的仙子或角色。
